project.title: Studies of Archaeal diversity during anaerobic digestion of chicken manure
project.description: The anaerobic digestion process is a promising technology for the treatment of chicken manure. However, anaerobic digestion of this protein-rich materials faces process instability issues at high feeding solid concentration due to ammonium accumulation and subsequent inhibition to methanogens, especially acetoclastic methanogens. The uniqueness of our research was to enhance methanogenic performance and metabolic pathways of anaerobic digestion of chicken manure by moderate in situ ammonia stripping through 194 days continuous experiment.
